<details>
The PKGBUILD contains only variable assignments at the top level -- no command substitutions, eval, or executable code that runs during sourcing. The single `source` entry points to web.archive.org (the Wayback Machine, a legitimate archival service), fetching a ZIP archive of the AACS key database. Extraction of a ZIP file writes files to disk but does not execute any code. The `package()` function (which merely installs a config file) is not reached due to `--nobuild --noprepare`. No data exfiltration, no execution of untrusted payloads, and no obfuscation occur during the sourcing or source-fetching phase.
</details>
